title: Manali, Umling La & Srinagar (12N/13D)
reportingPoint: The Volvo bus to Manali leaves Delhi at 6:30 PM on Day 0. The exact boarding point is shared once your booking is confirmed. The tour ends in Srinagar.
highlights: Atal Tunnel and Baralacha La, into Lahaul on the Leh-Manali highway
Sarchu, a night under a million stars
Gata Loops and Tanglang La, a day of high passes into Leh
Khardung La (18,380 ft), then Diskit and the dunes
Pangong Tso, the lake that changes colour
Hanle, Umling La (the world's highest motorable road) and Tso Moriri
overview:
The great Himalayan crossing: the Leh-Manali highway over Baralacha and Tanglang La, Khardung La and Nubra, Pangong Tso, Hanle, Umling La and Tso Moriri, then Kargil and Zoji La to Srinagar. It is a **12 Nights / 13 Days** fixed-departure group trip that starts with an overnight Volvo from Delhi to Manali and ends in Srinagar, with stays in hotels, camps and homestays and 15 meals across the trip.

Travel in a sitting coach (SIC) by Traveller or MUV, ride a Royal Enfield Himalayan solo or with a pillion, or bring your own bike. An oxygen cylinder rides in the car 24x7, with a mechanical backup vehicle and a team captain throughout. Prices start at ₹30,000 per person on triple sharing with your own bike, or ₹42,000 by SIC (5% GST extra). Reserve your seat with ₹8,000 and pay the rest 24 hours before boarding. Batches run every week in the summer season, June to early October, when the Leh-Manali highway is open; call us for 2027 dates.

itinerary.title: Delhi to Manali
itinerary.content: Depart Delhi by Volvo bus at 6:30 PM for the overnight journey to Manali.

itinerary.title: Manali: arrival and acclimatisation
itinerary.content:
Check in, freshen up, breakfast and a short trip briefing.
Self-explore Manali: Vashisht Temple, Hadimba Temple, Mall Road and Jogini Waterfall.
Early night at the hotel to rest for the adventure ahead.

itinerary.title: Manali to Sarchu
itinerary.content:
Breakfast, check out and start the famous Leh-Manali highway.
Through the Atal Tunnel into Lahaul, past Darcha and over Baralacha Pass.
Reach Sarchu by evening for a night under a million stars at the camp.

itinerary.title: Sarchu to Leh
itinerary.content:
A day of high passes: the Gata Loops, Nakee La and Lachung La.
Lunch on the More plains at Pang.
Over Tanglang La into Leh. Evening free to acclimatise; overnight in Leh.

itinerary.title: Leh to Nubra via Khardung La
itinerary.content:
After breakfast, ride over Khardung La (18,380 ft).
Visit Diskit Monastery and its 100 ft Buddha; camel and ATV rides are at your own cost.
Check in to the campsite for dinner and an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Nubra to Pangong Tso via Shyok
itinerary.content:
After breakfast, head to Pangong Tso via the Shyok route.
The lake changes colour through the day.
Dinner and overnight in a cottage.

itinerary.title: Pangong Tso to Hanle
itinerary.content:
Pangong to Hanle via Chushul, and a visit to the Hanle Observatory.
Overnight at a homestay.

itinerary.title: Hanle to Umling La and back
itinerary.content:
Ride from Hanle to Umling La, the world's highest motorable road, and back to Hanle.
Overnight at a homestay.

itinerary.title: Hanle to Tso Moriri
itinerary.content:
Ride from Hanle to Tso Moriri.
Overnight in a cottage.

itinerary.title: Tso Moriri to Leh
itinerary.content:
Ride back to Leh.
Overnight at the hotel.

itinerary.title: Leh to Kargil via Fotu La
itinerary.content: Ride from Leh to Kargil over Fotu La.

itinerary.title: Kargil to Srinagar via Zoji La
itinerary.content: Ride from Kargil to Srinagar over Zoji La.

faqs.q: Where does the trip start and end?
faqs.a: The trip starts in Delhi with the Volvo bus to Manali at 6:30 PM on Day 0, and ends in Srinagar on Day 12.

faqs.q: What are the travel options and what do they cost?
faqs.a: Per person on triple sharing: sitting coach (SIC) ₹42,000, RE Himalayan with pillion ₹42,000, RE Himalayan solo rider ₹55,000, and your own bike, solo, ₹30,000. On the own-bike options, double occupancy is ₹3,000 per person extra. 5% GST is extra.

Summer season only, from June to early October, when the Leh-Manali highway is open. Batches leave every week (for example 29 August to 10 September through 26 September to 8 October 2027). Call us for 2027 dates.

Stays in hotels, camps, cottages and homestays, all meals mentioned in the itinerary, the Volvo from Delhi to Manali, bike rent for the full route with fuel (bike option) or travel by Traveller / MUV (SIC), a mechanical and luggage backup vehicle, an oxygen cylinder 24x7, inner line permits and the Ladakh union fee, riding gear, a first-aid kit and a team captain.

5% GST, unspecified meals, room heater charges, entry and monument fees, personal expenses and tips, extra days due to weather or snow road blocks, any damage to the bike except engine damage, and costs from medical emergencies.

faqs.q: How do I book and pay?
faqs.a: Pick your batch and option, then call or WhatsApp us on +91 88008 41209. Reserve your seat with an advance of ₹8,000 per person by UPI, GPay, PhonePe, Paytm or net banking, and pay the balance 24 hours before boarding. 5% GST is extra on the trip price.
The ₹8,000 advance is not refunded under any circumstances. The balance is due 24 hours before boarding, and pending payments may cancel the booking. Bookings can't be transferred.
